caption: The drawing depicts the interior of an industrial foundry or metalworking shop with light gray brick walls and a high ceiling with several rectangular windows. The central focus is a large bronze or dark brown metal furnace on four legs with glowing pink-orange heat visible from its front opening. A metal crucible sits to the right of the furnace, with a pile of black coal or slag in front of it. In the foreground, there are multiple rectangular gray molds arranged on the floor, some stacked on the right. To the left side, a large circular metal vessel or mold hangs from a blue metal frame, with tongs and other tools leaning against the frame. Next to this is a small wooden table holding a lunch setup: a thermos, sandwich, bread, and other food items, as well as paper and a box. In the back, left of the furnace, another workspace holds additional metal tools, while against the right wall, shelves and hooks display a watering can, sieves, various long-handled tongs, scoops, and ladles. A wooden barrel, metal container, and a row of round-bottomed vessels are also visible. The overall color palette includes shades of gray, brown, black, metallic, beige, and blue, with pink and red highlights in the heated furnace area and on some of the food items.
title: Iron Foundry, 1910
